notes.sowing: Start seeds indoors 8 to 10 weeks before your last frost, {cm:0.6} deep, at {c:24} to {c:29}. Plant out 2 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once nights stay above {c:10}. Plants chill easily, so warm the soil under a cover for a couple of weeks first.
notes.care: Water about {cm:2.5} a week and mulch once the soil is warm. Flowering suffers above {c:32} or with cool nights. On large-fruited types, keep five or six fruits and remove later flowers. Stake heavy plants.
notes.harvest: Cut fruit with shears while the skin is still glossy and the flesh firm. Dull skin and brown seeds mean it is overripe. Fruit keeps about a week in the fridge.
